Contact & support
Where do you ship?

We offer free standard shipping to the contiguous 48 United States. For Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, APO/FPO/DPO and other special addresses, contact us before purchasing to confirm service. We do not currently ship internationally.

How long does delivery take?

Orders are processed within 1–3 business days after successful payment and confirmation, and ship from Addison, Illinois. Standard transit to the contiguous 48 states is estimated at 3–7 business days after dispatch. Estimates are not guaranteed delivery dates.

Can I return my leash?

Yes. Request a return within 30 calendar days of receiving your product. Change-of-mind returns must be unused, unwashed and in original packaging, and the customer pays return postage. We cover return shipping for defective, damaged or incorrect items. Email us before sending anything back.

How do I pay?

Choose your color on the product page and tap Buy now — checkout is handled securely by Stripe, and no account is needed. Set the quantity on the Stripe page (up to 5 per order). We never see or store your card details.

Do I need an account?

No. An account is optional: it saves your cart and shipping address so you can pick up on any device.

How big is the leash?

Each leash is 1.5 m long and 1.0 cm wide, with a padded loop handle and a clip that attaches to your dog’s collar or harness.
